title: Service Unavailable
scenario: The order summary asks Shipping for a delivery estimate. Investigate what happens when Shipping becomes unavailable.
objective: Determine whether the main order summary remains usable when Shipping is unavailable.
hints: Look at both error rate and response time.
Should a missing delivery estimate make the entire order summary fail?

resilienceOptions.label: Wait longer for Shipping
resilienceOptions.description: Give Shipping more time before the whole request fails.

resilienceOptions.label: Retry once
resilienceOptions.description: Try the unavailable dependency again before returning an error.

resilienceOptions.label: Continue without an estimate
resilienceOptions.description: Keep the order summary available and clearly mark the delivery estimate as unavailable.

resilienceOptions.label: Retry once, then continue without an estimate
resilienceOptions.description: Try again once, then keep the summary available if Shipping is still unavailable.
